protocol.title: fixed-budget unsuppressed recovery dynamics after route-commitment intervention
protocol.status: twelve recovery sources, frozen baseline groups, training budget, milestones, panels, and outcomes registered before continuation
protocol.hypothesis: The Level 7.5.3 deficits primarily reflect delayed long-context formation rather than permanent rerouting. With all masks removed and a common additional 1000-step C4 budget, the six previously unformed endpoints will recover their source-specific original route while the six already formed endpoints remain on that route.

trajectory_screen_panel.purpose: Estimate recovery timing and expected dominant retention without replacing final classification.
trajectory_screen_panel.screen_recovery_proxy: intact >=0.90, minimum local >=0.90, and the expected layer has larger single-layer retention

registered_outcomes.complete_unsuppressed_route_recovery: all six initially unformed recover the original route and all six initially formed preserve it
registered_outcomes.partial_unsuppressed_route_recovery: one to five initially unformed recover while all initially formed preserve the original route
registered_outcomes.persistent_long_context_generalization_d: none of the initially unformed recover while all initially formed preserve the original route
registered_outcomes.continued_C4_destabilizes_preformed_rout: one or more initially formed branches loses its original route
registered_outcomes.opposite_layer_route_migration_observed: one or more endpoints forms the opposite L2/L3 route; precedence over recovery counts
registered_outcomes.formal_integrity_failed_recovery_interpr: a source, schedule, checkpoint, screen, or confirmation gate fails

protocol.scope: This distinguishes recovery delay from persistent fixed-budget long-context deficit. It does not isolate forward-state, gradient-path, or Probe-loss mechanisms. The six formed branches are mandatory stability controls for continued C4 training.
protocol.stop_rule: Report the fixed +1000-step recovery trajectories. Do not add recovery steps, alter panels, or reassign baseline groups.

diagnosis.registered_stop_boundary: Report the fixed +1000-step recovery trajectories; do not add recovery steps, change panels, or reclassify the frozen baseline groups.
